notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata fetch targets an unimplemented /api/metadata endpoint and does not handle favicon or preview image.
REF-BM-03: Title and description can be changed before saving, but saved bookmarks cannot be edited.
REF-BM-04: No saved-bookmark editing workflow exists.
REF-BM-05: No delete action exists.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are inserted as new bookmarks without detection or edit guidance.
REF-BM-07: Cards show title, description, and tags, but only a generated placeholder rather than the page favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry has no autocomplete.
REF-BM-11: Displayed tags are not selectable filters.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, domain, description, and tags, but not notes or the complete URL.
REF-BM-14: #tag syntax is not parsed or matched.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised groups are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not interpreted as exact matches.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state can be set.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: No mark-as-read action exists.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk action support.
REF-BM-21: There is no current-filter-wide bulk action support.
REF-BM-23: The form's Note field is stored as plain description text and markdown is not rendered.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML or PDF snapshot functionality exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-27: Archive and restore are implemented, but permanent deletion is not.
REF-BM-29: Static collections are not reusable dynamic bundles with search and include/exclude tags.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import exists.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export exists.
REF-BM-32: The Settings control is inert and no personal display settings are implemented.
